name: read__fabric_filtered_request
description: Locks the FabricFiltered=true ReadRequest path at scenario level: peer ships a ReadRequestMessage with the FabricFiltered flag set (Matter §10.6.3), the bridge stamps the FabricFiltered+FabricIndex into the dispatch context (im.WithFabricFilter), and replies with a ReportData on the same exchange. Cluster servers that implement [interfaces.FabricScopedReader] then project per-fabric. The scenario exercises the wire-level path against the single_onoff_endpoint_source topology — the OnOff cluster is not fabric-scoped, but the bridge MUST still honor the request flag and reply rather than dropping or panicking. Per-fabric output verification (different fabric indexes yielding different attribute payloads) stays queued behind a real FabricScopedReader fake in topology.
